title: Leveraging Large Language Models for Causal Discovery: a Constraint-based, Argumentation-driven Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Developing a synthetic evaluation protocol that generates novel causal graphs by grounding random Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) in the CauseNet knowledge graph to distinguish genuine causal reasoning from the verbatim retrieval of standard, publicly available causal discovery benchmarks seen during pre-training.
